work.title: The First Part of Henry the Sixth
work.author: William Shakespeare

scene.label: Act 2, Scene 5
scene.title: SCENE V. The Tower of London.

content.text: Enter Mortimer, brought in a chair, and Jailers.

lines.text: Kind keepers of my weak decaying age,
lines.plainText: Kind keepers of my weak decaying age

lines.text: Let dying Mortimer here rest himself.
lines.plainText: Let dying Mortimer here rest himself

lines.text: Even like a man new haled from the rack,
lines.plainText: Even like a man new haled from the rack

lines.text: So fare my limbs with long imprisonment;
lines.plainText: So fare my limbs with long imprisonment

lines.text: And these gray locks, the pursuivants of death,
lines.plainText: And these gray locks the pursuivants of death

lines.text: Nestor-like aged in an age of care,
lines.plainText: Nestorlike aged in an age of care

lines.text: Argue the end of Edmund Mortimer.
lines.plainText: Argue the end of Edmund Mortimer

lines.text: These eyes, like lamps whose wasting oil is spent,
lines.plainText: These eyes like lamps whose wasting oil is spent

lines.text: Wax dim, as drawing to their exigent;
lines.plainText: Wax dim as drawing to their exigent

lines.text: Weak shoulders, overborne with burdening grief,
lines.plainText: Weak shoulders overborne with burdening grief

lines.text: And pithless arms, like to a wither'd vine
lines.plainText: And pithless arms like to a wither'd vine

lines.text: That droops his sapless branches to the ground.
lines.plainText: That droops his sapless branches to the ground

lines.text: Yet are these feet, whose strengthless stay is numb,
lines.plainText: Yet are these feet whose strengthless stay is numb

lines.text: Unable to support this lump of clay,
lines.plainText: Unable to support this lump of clay

lines.text: Swift-winged with desire to get a grave,
lines.plainText: Swiftwinged with desire to get a grave

lines.text: As witting I no other comfort have.
lines.plainText: As witting I no other comfort have

lines.text: But tell me, keeper, will my nephew come?
lines.plainText: But tell me keeper will my nephew come

lines.text: Richard Plantagenet, my lord, will come.
lines.plainText: Richard Plantagenet my lord will come

lines.text: We sent unto the Temple, unto his chamber,
lines.plainText: We sent unto the Temple unto his chamber

lines.text: And answer was return'd that he will come.
lines.plainText: And answer was return'd that he will come

lines.text: Enough. My soul shall then be satisfied.
lines.plainText: Enough My soul shall then be satisfied

lines.text: Poor gentleman, his wrong doth equal mine.
lines.plainText: Poor gentleman his wrong doth equal mine

lines.text: Since Henry Monmouth first began to reign,
lines.plainText: Since Henry Monmouth first began to reign

lines.text: Before whose glory I was great in arms,
lines.plainText: Before whose glory I was great in arms

lines.text: This loathsome sequestration have I had;
lines.plainText: This loathsome sequestration have I had

lines.text: And even since then hath Richard been obscured,
lines.plainText: And even since then hath Richard been obscured

lines.text: Deprived of honour and inheritance.
lines.plainText: Deprived of honour and inheritance

lines.text: But now the arbitrator of despairs,
lines.plainText: But now the arbitrator of despairs

lines.text: Just Death, kind umpire of men's miseries,
lines.plainText: Just Death kind umpire of men's miseries

lines.text: With sweet enlargement doth dismiss me hence.
lines.plainText: With sweet enlargement doth dismiss me hence

lines.text: I would his troubles likewise were expired,
lines.plainText: I would his troubles likewise were expired

lines.text: That so he might recover what was lost.
lines.plainText: That so he might recover what was lost

lines.text: My lord, your loving nephew now is come.
lines.plainText: My lord your loving nephew now is come

lines.text: Richard Plantagenet, my friend, is he come?
lines.plainText: Richard Plantagenet my friend is he come

lines.text: Ay, noble uncle, thus ignobly used,
lines.plainText: Ay noble uncle thus ignobly used

lines.text: Your nephew, late despised Richard, comes.
lines.plainText: Your nephew late despised Richard comes

lines.text: Direct mine arms I may embrace his neck
lines.plainText: Direct mine arms I may embrace his neck

lines.text: And in his bosom spend my latter gasp.
lines.plainText: And in his bosom spend my latter gasp

lines.text: O, tell me when my lips do touch his cheeks,
lines.plainText: O tell me when my lips do touch his cheeks

lines.text: That I may kindly give one fainting kiss.
lines.plainText: That I may kindly give one fainting kiss

lines.text: And now declare, sweet stem from York's great stock,
lines.plainText: And now declare sweet stem from York's great stock

lines.text: Why didst thou say of late thou wert despised?
lines.plainText: Why didst thou say of late thou wert despised

lines.text: First, lean thine aged back against mine arm,
lines.plainText: First lean thine aged back against mine arm

lines.text: And, in that ease, I'll tell thee my disease.
lines.plainText: And in that ease I'll tell thee my disease

lines.text: This day, in argument upon a case,
lines.plainText: This day in argument upon a case

lines.text: Some words there grew 'twixt Somerset and me;
lines.plainText: Some words there grew 'twixt Somerset and me

lines.text: Among which terms he used his lavish tongue
lines.plainText: Among which terms he used his lavish tongue

lines.text: And did upbraid me with my father's death;
lines.plainText: And did upbraid me with my father's death

lines.text: Which obloquy set bars before my tongue,
lines.plainText: Which obloquy set bars before my tongue

lines.text: Else with the like I had requited him.
lines.plainText: Else with the like I had requited him

lines.text: Therefore, good uncle, for my father's sake,
lines.plainText: Therefore good uncle for my father's sake

lines.text: In honour of a true Plantagenet,
lines.plainText: In honour of a true Plantagenet

lines.text: And for alliance' sake, declare the cause
lines.plainText: And for alliance' sake declare the cause

lines.text: My father, Earl of Cambridge, lost his head.
lines.plainText: My father Earl of Cambridge lost his head

lines.text: That cause, fair nephew, that imprison'd me
lines.plainText: That cause fair nephew that imprison'd me

lines.text: And hath detain'd me all my flowering youth
lines.plainText: And hath detain'd me all my flowering youth

lines.text: Within a loathsome dungeon, there to pine,
lines.plainText: Within a loathsome dungeon there to pine

lines.text: Was cursed instrument of his decease.
lines.plainText: Was cursed instrument of his decease

lines.text: Discover more at large what cause that was,
lines.plainText: Discover more at large what cause that was

lines.text: For I am ignorant and cannot guess.
lines.plainText: For I am ignorant and cannot guess

lines.text: I will, if that my fading breath permit
lines.plainText: I will if that my fading breath permit

lines.text: And death approach not ere my tale be done.
lines.plainText: And death approach not ere my tale be done

lines.text: Henry the Fourth, grandfather to this king,
lines.plainText: Henry the Fourth grandfather to this king

lines.text: Deposed his nephew Richard, Edward's son,
lines.plainText: Deposed his nephew Richard Edward's son

lines.text: The first-begotten and the lawful heir
lines.plainText: The firstbegotten and the lawful heir

lines.text: Of Edward king, the third of that descent;
lines.plainText: Of Edward king the third of that descent

lines.text: During whose reign the Percies of the north,
lines.plainText: During whose reign the Percies of the north

lines.text: Finding his usurpation most unjust,
lines.plainText: Finding his usurpation most unjust

lines.text: Endeavour'd my advancement to the throne.
lines.plainText: Endeavour'd my advancement to the throne

lines.text: The reason moved these warlike lords to this
lines.plainText: The reason moved these warlike lords to this

lines.text: Was, for that—young King Richard thus removed,
lines.plainText: Was for thatyoung King Richard thus removed

lines.text: Leaving no heir begotten of his body—
lines.plainText: Leaving no heir begotten of his body

lines.text: I was the next by birth and parentage;
lines.plainText: I was the next by birth and parentage

lines.text: For by my mother I derived am
lines.plainText: For by my mother I derived am

lines.text: From Lionel Duke of Clarence, third son
lines.plainText: From Lionel Duke of Clarence third son

lines.text: To King Edward the Third; whereas he
lines.plainText: To King Edward the Third whereas he

lines.text: From John of Gaunt doth bring his pedigree,
lines.plainText: From John of Gaunt doth bring his pedigree

lines.text: Being but fourth of that heroic line.
lines.plainText: Being but fourth of that heroic line

lines.text: But mark: as in this haughty great attempt
lines.plainText: But mark as in this haughty great attempt

lines.text: They labored to plant the rightful heir,
lines.plainText: They labored to plant the rightful heir

lines.text: I lost my liberty and they their lives.
lines.plainText: I lost my liberty and they their lives

lines.text: Long after this, when Henry the Fifth,
lines.plainText: Long after this when Henry the Fifth

lines.text: Succeeding his father Bolingbroke, did reign,
lines.plainText: Succeeding his father Bolingbroke did reign

lines.text: Thy father, Earl of Cambridge then, derived
lines.plainText: Thy father Earl of Cambridge then derived

lines.text: From famous Edmund Langley, Duke of York,
lines.plainText: From famous Edmund Langley Duke of York

lines.text: Marrying my sister that thy mother was,
lines.plainText: Marrying my sister that thy mother was

lines.text: Again, in pity of my hard distress.
lines.plainText: Again in pity of my hard distress

lines.text: Levied an army, weening to redeem
lines.plainText: Levied an army weening to redeem

lines.text: And have install'd me in the diadem.
lines.plainText: And have install'd me in the diadem

lines.text: But, as the rest, so fell that noble earl
lines.plainText: But as the rest so fell that noble earl

lines.text: And was beheaded. Thus the Mortimers,
lines.plainText: And was beheaded Thus the Mortimers

lines.text: In whom the title rested, were suppress'd.
lines.plainText: In whom the title rested were suppress'd

lines.text: Of which, my lord, your honour is the last.
lines.plainText: Of which my lord your honour is the last

lines.text: True; and thou seest that I no issue have,
lines.plainText: True and thou seest that I no issue have

lines.text: And that my fainting words do warrant death.
lines.plainText: And that my fainting words do warrant death

lines.text: Thou art my heir; the rest I wish thee gather.
lines.plainText: Thou art my heir the rest I wish thee gather

lines.text: But yet be wary in thy studious care.
lines.plainText: But yet be wary in thy studious care

lines.text: Thy grave admonishments prevail with me.
lines.plainText: Thy grave admonishments prevail with me

lines.text: But yet methinks, my father's execution
lines.plainText: But yet methinks my father's execution

lines.text: Was nothing less than bloody tyranny.
lines.plainText: Was nothing less than bloody tyranny

lines.text: With silence, nephew, be thou politic;
lines.plainText: With silence nephew be thou politic

lines.text: Strong-fixed is the house of Lancaster,
lines.plainText: Strongfixed is the house of Lancaster

lines.text: And like a mountain, not to be removed.
lines.plainText: And like a mountain not to be removed

lines.text: But now thy uncle is removing hence,
lines.plainText: But now thy uncle is removing hence

lines.text: As princes do their courts when they are cloy'd
lines.plainText: As princes do their courts when they are cloy'd

lines.text: With long continuance in a settled place.
lines.plainText: With long continuance in a settled place

lines.text: O uncle, would some part of my young years
lines.plainText: O uncle would some part of my young years

lines.text: Might but redeem the passage of your age!
lines.plainText: Might but redeem the passage of your age

lines.text: Thou dost then wrong me, as that slaughterer doth
lines.plainText: Thou dost then wrong me as that slaughterer doth

lines.text: Which giveth many wounds when one will kill.
lines.plainText: Which giveth many wounds when one will kill

lines.text: Mourn not, except thou sorrow for my good;
lines.plainText: Mourn not except thou sorrow for my good

lines.text: Only give order for my funeral.
lines.plainText: Only give order for my funeral

lines.text: And so farewell, and fair be all thy hopes,
lines.plainText: And so farewell and fair be all thy hopes

lines.text: And prosperous be thy life in peace and war!
lines.plainText: And prosperous be thy life in peace and war

lines.text: And peace, no war, befall thy parting soul!
lines.plainText: And peace no war befall thy parting soul

lines.text: In prison hast thou spent a pilgrimage,
lines.plainText: In prison hast thou spent a pilgrimage

lines.text: And like a hermit overpass'd thy days.
lines.plainText: And like a hermit overpass'd thy days

lines.text: Well, I will lock his counsel in my breast;
lines.plainText: Well I will lock his counsel in my breast

lines.text: And what I do imagine, let that rest.
lines.plainText: And what I do imagine let that rest

lines.text: Keepers, convey him hence; and I myself
lines.plainText: Keepers convey him hence and I myself

lines.text: Will see his burial better than his life.
lines.plainText: Will see his burial better than his life

content.text: [Exeunt Jailers, bearing out the body of Mortimer.]
